value.author: Abdessamad
value.title: Exceptional
value.text: Kamer was zeer ruim en erg comfortabel en de persoonlijke aandacht van alle personeel was zeker een pluspunt. Ontbijt was ook zeer ruim uitgebreid. Voor mijn volgende bezoek aan Istanbul is dit mijn vaste hotel

value.author: Richard
value.title: Exceptional
value.text:
Bel hôtel parfaitement rénové, confortable. Décoration classique mais avantageuse. Les chambres sont grandes. Tout paraît récent. Ou alors parfaitement entretenu. Très bonne literie. Le personnel est au top. La piscine est faite pour les nageurs et le fitness est complet. Le rapport qualité prix est très concurrentiel.
— Nous avons été  relativement déçus par le petit-déjeuner qui manque à notre goût de caractère et offre des produits un peu décevants dans une salle plutôt triste. Donc peut mieux faire dans ce domaine.

value.author: Karrar
value.title: ممتازة
value.text:
الفندق قريب من اغلب الاماكن والخدمة والنضافة ممتازة
— لا شي

value.author: Alireza
value.title: It was a good stay overall.
value.text:
The location was fine, and it was close to the part of the city that you want to go to, especially if you have a car. The alley had a lot of construction going on, which made the commute with the car a little bit difficult, but the parking valet was very helpful. We stayed in the Junior Suite which was nice and large, and we asked for two additional single beds, which were provided for us for free because we had booked it for four people initially.
— The breakfast did not meet the expectations at all. Neither in veriety, nor freshness or quality. The towels are too worn out sometimes. The water in the shower would come out of shower if you let the water run for more than a few minutes, so we had to constantly open and close it in between.

value.author: Abdiqani
value.title: I will not recommend to anyone to go to that hotel
value.text:
There’s nothing I like about the hotel
— $7700 were stolen from me at the hotel.
Staff never help me track my money.
I was charged extra $230 fee for no reason.
I was charged $34 for using a soda in the refrigerator in my room and there is no sign or they never told me that the sodas were not free

value.author: Ayad
value.title: Tak til receptionspersonalet, som var venlige.
value.text:
Det var rent, komfortabelt, og beliggenheden var praktisk for mig.

Personalet var venligt og nemt at have med at gøre.

Tak for deres samarbejde og venlighed
— Servicen var god, men den ville have været bedre, hvis det ikke var for hotelchefen, som var usamarbejdsvillig.

value.text: All staff are kind and freindly

value.author: Ciobanu
value.title: Very Poor
value.text:
Nimic
— O experienta pe care nu o recomand sub nicio forma

Am stat 5 nopti la acest hotel, in perioada 24-29 august, si din pacate experienta a fost una extrem de neplacuta.

Hotelul este vechi, cu mobilier invechit si camere care au nevoie evidenta de renovare. Micul dejun a fost pur si simplu inacceptabil. Am incercat o singura data, in prima zi, dupa care am preferat sa nu mai revenim deloc.

Parcarea este prezentata ca fiind gratuita, ceea ce este adevarat, dar trebuie sa fii foarte ferm si sa precizezi ca vrei sa parchezi in subteran. Altfel, ti se propune sa lasi masina pe strada. Nu mi se pare normal ca, pentru a beneficia de parcarea hotelului, sa trebuiasca sa insisti pentru acest lucru.

La sosire ni s-a cerut un depozit de aproximativ 100 de euro, in cazul in care am deteriora ceva in camera. Aceasta conditie nu era mentionata nicaieri in momentul rezervarii. Consideram ca orice garantie financiara trebuie comunicata clar clientului inainte de sosire, nu prezentata ca o surpriza la receptie.

Mai mult, la rezervare era specificat ca vom fi cazati la un etaj superior. Cu toate acestea, am primit camera 1023, la etajul 1. Daca rezervarea spune un anumit tip de camera sau un anumit etaj, ne asteptam ca acest lucru sa fie respectat.

Un alt mare minus este situatia din jurul hotelului: strada este in renovare, cu foarte mult praf si zgomot. Practic, atmosfera din jur este cea a unui santier.

In concluzie, foarte putine lucruri au fost asa cum ne asteptam din descrierea hotelului. Conditiile, micul dejun, camera, depozitul solicitat la sosire, parcarea si lucrarile din fata hotelului au facut ca acest sejur sa fie o experienta pe care nu am repeta-o.

Singurul lucru pozitiv pe care il putem spune este ca, dupa toate cele intamplate, am plecat fara sa avem probleme cu plosnitele.

Cu siguranta nu vom reveni si nu recomandam acest hotel.

value.author: Rabia
value.title: Exceptional
value.text:
فندق رائع، خدمه ممتازه، اعجبني الفصل بين النساء والرجال وعدم وجود الخمور. الغرف جميله جدا وواسعه، الطاقم رائع وبشوش.
اخص بالذكر السيده إيمان في الاستقبال، رائعه ومتعوانه الى اقصى حد
— لا شيء
